rewrites.comment: SPA fallback, minus the paths that must never receive HTML. Without the negative lookahead a mistyped /api/... answered 200 with the app shell, so a broken endpoint looked like a working page to every client and to Search Console. Static assets are excluded for the same reason: a missing .js should 404, not return index.html with a JavaScript content type.

headers.comment: Hashed build output: the filename changes with the content, so it can be cached forever.
The app shell and the service worker must never be browser-cached, or a deploy stays invisible until the user clears storage. The worker is also what discovers new builds.

nosniff stops a browser guessing a content type from the body; the referrer policy keeps lyric and OAuth paths out of third-party logs; the permissions policy turns off hardware this app never requests. Deliberately no CSP yet: the app needs fonts.googleapis.com, youtube.com iframes and blob: workers, and a policy written without testing them would break playback. Deliberately no X-Frame-Options either - the /obs overlay is meant to be embedded.
